monthly_relevance_encoding: Within each training calendar month, continuous target is converted to ordinal quintile relevance 0..4. Thresholds are estimated only from that training month.

training_schedules.EXPANDING: Original expanding training period ending at calibration start.
training_schedules.ROLLING_12M: Most recent up-to-12 calendar months before calibration start; first fold uses all available six months.

robustness: same frozen bootstrap, matched-random, pseudo-state and parameter-neighborhood controls
consumed_2026: diagnostic only after survivor freeze; not selection or support
no_rescue: no reuse of 2026 as untouched evidence
